name: 29667-longtextimage-internvl8b-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: InternVLChatModel (`trust_remote_code`, `auto_map`), bf16, ~8.5B: a 36-layer Qwen3 decoder (32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128) plus a ~300M InternViT tower with dynamic tiling at 256 tokens per tile. All of it is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1, bounded at 200 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 20% by completion, no cooldown.
workload: One image plus a long text prompt per request, one turn. Two composed synthetic sources: `synthetic_text` pinned to exactly 5000 prompt tokens and 100 output tokens (min = max on both), and `synthetic_image` at the 480p preset (854x480, one image per row, PNG, gradient content, seed 42). `temperature: 0.0`. The engine is driven in-process through guidellm's `vllm_python` backend, so there is no network term in the latency.
purpose: A vision-language assistant describing one 480p image with a long text prompt, single-stream on one GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit 6173682b6e98ae62f612db7af6813831097b23dc (`git describe --tags` =
# v0.11.1-383-g6173682b6e98). No released wheel is this tree; configs/env.yaml says where the
# built checkout lives on this machine. The engine is driven in-process, so the host/port/api-key
# flags of an HTTP `vllm serve` have nothing to configure and are absent.

model: OpenGVLab/InternVL3_5-8B

# Required, not decorative: the checkpoint ships its own config and image-processor classes
# through `auto_map`.
trust-remote-code: true

tensor-parallel-size: 1

max-model-len: 32768

limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 1}
